title: Ezetimibe and Atorvastatin vs. Atorvastatin in Patients Age 65 and Older at High Risk for Coronary Heart Disease (CHD)(0653-112)

sections.abstract:
A 12 week clinical trial in patients 65 years of age and older with hypercholesterolemia at high risk for coronary heart disease to study the effects of atorvastatin and ezetimibe given in combination and two higher doses of atorvastatin on lipid lowering.

Posted outcomes: Percent Change From Baseline in LDL-C at Week 6. timeframe=Baseline and Week 6. Atorva 10 mg + EZ=-26.7; Atorva 20 mg / Atorva 40 mg=-12.8. p=<0.001
